answer: One concrete mechanism: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because raven only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, bridge is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any trellis approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
